description: Single source of truth for every ground-truth target metric the local-label pipeline can carry. Each entry binds a canonical Nsight Compute metric identifier to the label-style sidecar/admitted field names, its unit, valid range, parser transform, aggregation/repeatability rule, nullable policy, and deployability (label-only vs feature-eligible). registry_version 2 additionally pins, for every entry, a metric_class (HOW the value is produced), a risk_tier (how hard it is to reproduce without privileged counters), an ncu_observation_contract (the counting-unit / rollup / numerator / denominator / op-classes the Nsight Compute identifier observes), and a per_arch_availability map (sm_86 host-observed status; sm_120 deferred). Derived entries (derived_ratio / derived_pct_peak) additionally carry a composition block whose formula references dependency metric KEYS and device-constant names as bare identifiers. The hit-rate fraction metrics (L2 mandatory, L1/TEX) keep the historical flat field names and the percentage parser transform; every non-percentage family (cycles, ns, count) is carried under the unit_tagged_metrics block introduced at label_schema_version 5. The label_field names are deliberately chosen to avoid tools/local_labels/import_label.py's forbidden-field denylist (no metric_*/counter_*/event_*/pm_*/cupti_* prefixes). The availability column is the host-observed status; entries marked probe_pending are confirmed against this card by the metric-availability probe artifact, and unresolved entries (no settled canonical identifier yet) must be resolved by the probe before any head may target them. [2026-07-06 1B extension: +18 warp_stall entries (Warp State stall reasons) and the SOL headline pair; every entry now carries model_io_role (target|input|either) — the Rule-1 successor of deployability, which is retained until consumers migrate.] [2026-07-07 §6.4 correction: the three sector/request-stream observation contracts over LTS and unified L1TEX (cache_hit_rate_l2_sector, traffic_l2_total_requests_from_tex, and the unified l1tex sector hit-rate) now list global_atomic and global_reduction op classes — Nsight Compute's lts__t_sectors/l1tex__t_sectors streams include ATOM/RED sectors (op_atom/op_red rollups exist and the ac4_global_atomic_histogram cell's 99.9% L2 label is RED-dominated); the previous lists under-documented the stream. Per-op-ld contracts are unchanged. Vocabulary note: the pre-existing aggregate L1 total-requests contract spells the same physical classes as bare 'atomic'/'reduction' tokens; both spellings are deliberately outside the op-class gate vocabulary consumers use (emit_ac4_load_bearing_coverage._GATEABLE_OP_CLASSES contains the global_-prefixed forms only, and the aggregate entries carry bare 'local'/'texture'/'surface' tokens that keep them ungated either way) — harmonize when the sim-emit contract layer regenerates the registry, not piecemeal.] [2026-07-08 sim-emit resolution: the sim-emit contract layer (sim/emit) landed and does NOT consume the ncu_observation_contract op_classes lists (it binds only key/ncu_metric/unit/valid_max/parser_transform/model_io_role per descriptor, checked by the registry_lockstep test); the bare-vs-global_-prefixed op-class vocabulary is therefore an eval/label-factory concern, not a sim-emit one, and needs NO rename — the per-op global_-prefixed contracts and the space-agnostic aggregate total-requests bare tokens coexist by design. Harmonization item CLOSED.]

composition.note: Frozen L2 sector hit-rate is consumed directly as a calibration label from Nsight Compute's own lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct rollup. The honest predictor-side L2 sector denominator (LTS input sectors net of the L1-write stream) is validated downstream and is NOT yet expressible from registered primitives, so no predictor composition is asserted here; the registered cross-level traffic keys (traffic_dram_read_sectors, traffic_l2_total_requests_from_tex) approximate but do not equal the LTS sector denominator.

metrics.notes: Mandatory frozen L2 sector hit-rate target; consumed by the frozen sm_86 v5 calibration head. Path unchanged.

composition.note: Unified L1TEX sector hit-rate is consumed directly from Nsight Compute's own l1tex__t_sector_hit_rate.pct rollup until registered primitives expose the matching unified sector numerator/denominator. The prior read-stream approximation was not dimensionally aligned with this unified denominator.

metrics.notes: L1/TEX unified sector hit-rate. Already carried on admitted sm_86 cells; promoted to a load-bearing predicted target by the L1-promotion work (separate bounded calibration head).

composition.note: Global-load L1TEX sector hit-rate is consumed directly from Nsight Compute's l1tex__t_sector_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld_hit_rate.pct rollup until a global-load-only miss primitive is registered. The available xbar2l1 read-sector stream includes local/global loads and cannot be divided by the global-only sector denominator.

Canonical resolution of read_ncu_report.py's get_L1_Total_Requests. The metric-availability probe confirmed l1tex__t_requests.sum is available on this card (RTX 3090 Ti, GA102, ncu_2026.1.x) and Codex ratified it as the correct canonical identifier for 'L1 total requests' (vs a per-pipe sum); availability is therefore 'available'. label_only deployability: it is an NCU-counter label, not a deployable inference feature.
ACHIEVED occupancy. Counter-derived; captured as a label/diagnostic only and never admissible as a deployable inference feature (no-deployability-leakage contract).

composition.note: Instructions per elapsed cycle composed from the SMSP instruction-executed sum normalized by SM count and elapsed GPC cycles: smsp_inst_executed_sum / (sm_count * exec_cycles_gpc_max). This aligns the GPU-wide instruction sum with NCU's SM-average per-cycle-elapsed rollup.

metrics.notes: Instructions per elapsed cycle. Counter-derived; captured as a label/diagnostic only and never admissible as a deployable inference feature (no-deployability-leakage contract).

Theoretical (static-derivable) occupancy limit. Feature-eligible: may be a predictor input because it is launch-geometry-derivable without privileged counters. per_arch_availability.sm_86 is 'available' because the occupancy calculator computes it from launch geometry and device constants; the counter-side availability column stays 'excluded' to record that it is NOT counter-sourced on this card.

Theoretical block-limited occupancy bound (max_blocks_per_sm). Feature-eligible: computed by the occupancy calculator from launch geometry + device constants, NOT counter-sourced; per_arch_availability.sm_86 'available' (calculator-derivable) while the counter availability column stays 'excluded'.

Theoretical register-limited occupancy bound (registers_per_sm / per-thread register count under register/warp allocation granularity). Feature-eligible: computed by the occupancy calculator, NOT counter-sourced; per_arch_availability.sm_86 'available' (calculator-derivable) while the counter availability column stays 'excluded'.

Shared-memory-limited occupancy bound. UNLIKE warps/blocks/registers (exact from pure-static launch geometry + device constants), this limit depends on the launch's CONFIGURED shared-memory carveout (launch__shared_mem_config_size, a runtime/driver decision) plus the driver-reserved per-block shared memory: limit = configured_carveout // round_up(static + dynamic + reserved_shared_memory_per_block_bytes, shared_mem_allocation_unit_bytes). The pure-static inputs do NOT determine the configured carveout, so per_arch_availability.sm_86 is 'requires_runtime_carveout': the occupancy calculator resolves it typed_unavailable (reason requires_runtime_shared_mem_carveout) without a carveout, and exact only when a carveout is supplied (validated 8192 -> 8 vs NCU). Feature-eligible as a deployable static feature when the carveout is provided; the counter availability column stays 'excluded' (not counter-sourced).
Total warp instructions executed (SMSP sum). Replay-count primitive; the IPC composition divides it by exec_cycles_gpc_max.
Average active-SM cycle count (DVFS-bound timing covariate).
Mean resident warps per active cycle. Counter-derived occupancy diagnostic; label-only.
Observed SM (GPC) clock rate covariate in Hz (elapsed cycles per second). DVFS-state covariate; the unit 'count' tags it as a non-percentage scalar carried under the unit-tagged block.

composition.note: Achieved DRAM bytes/second = total DRAM sectors moved (read+write) * sector_size_bytes, divided by the kernel duration in seconds (exec_duration_ns / 1e9). A derived rate, not a percentage-of-peak.

metrics.notes: Achieved DRAM throughput in bytes/second (derived rate). Composed from DRAM sector counts and kernel duration; label-only. Probed available on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti (ncu_2026.1.x) by the 2026-06-04 regeneration of ncu_metric_availability_probe_sm_86.json (43-target catalog query).

composition.note: Provisional speed-of-light proxy for the compute-memory-access throughput percentage: achieved DRAM bandwidth fraction, clamped to 1.0. This is NOT the exact NCU per-subsystem speed-of-light (the max over SM/L1/L2/DRAM subsystem utilizations); device_constants.json carries no per-subsystem peak, only peak_dram_bytes_per_s, so the exact composition is a downstream timing-model refinement. Resolves typed_unavailable on sm_86 while dram_bytes_per_second is per_arch probe_pending, and on sm_120 (deferred), so no number is published yet.
